identity.fantasy: A sunrise-and-sunset caster who alternates Holy and Fire to build opposing sides, then releases Scorch, Ray, Rapture, and Sun Down payoffs.
identity.one_line: Alternate Sunrise and Sunset through Dawn, cast the matching Holy or Fire mini-rotation, then exploit Rapture and Horusath procs.

mechanics.core_loop: A dual-school caster alternating Sunrise and Sunset. Holy spells empower one side, Fire spells the other, while Scorch Marks and Sun Ray feed large Rapture, Horusath Blast, and Sun Down payoffs. It rewards deliberate school sequencing rather than one-school spam.
mechanics.single_target: On durable targets, the structural path grows from Dawnsear, Sunrise and Sunset, Radiant Flame toward Burning Heat, Sun Down, Duality of Light. A precise priority remains limited to the captured build and community evidence.
mechanics.aoe: For multiple targets, Alternate Sunrise and Sunset through Dawn, cast the matching Holy or Fire mini-rotation, then exploit Rapture and Horusath procs. The current evidence particularly constrains this through: A Piety player needed several WeakAuras before the better-boomkin loop clicked around 40.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Ranged play offers space, but its best sequence may involve hard-cast and school-order commitments.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Its structural defensive package includes Sun Gate, City of Light, Radiant Fury, Lights of Absolution, Burn The Heretics.
mechanics.group_utility: Group or control tools include Sun's Hope, Sun Gate, Sunwell, Burn The Heretics.
